question: Estimate the annual advertising revenue of Meta (Facebook + Instagram + WhatsApp) from India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total ad revenue from India advertisers across Meta platforms? Yes.
Includes WhatsApp Business + Click-to-WhatsApp ads? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian advertisers on Meta: ~25-30 lakh active monthly (SMBs + large brands).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Long tail SMBs: ~₹50K-2 lakh each = ~₹3,000 Cr.

calculationFlow: Indian advertisers on Meta: ~25-30 lakh active monthly (SMBs + large brands).
- Mid-tier ~50,000 D2C / SMBs: ~₹10-30 lakh each = ~₹12,000 Cr.
- Long tail SMBs: ~₹50K-2 lakh each = ~₹3,000 Cr.
Total Meta India ad revenue: ~₹30,000 Cr annually (~$3.6B).
